test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct in the context to Aurora Borealis?

options.text: It is mainly seen in the equatorial region.
It is a beautiful natural light seen in the earth's sky.
The emission of nitrogen into the Earth's atmosphere produces polar radiation (auroras).
It is also called Southern Lights.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It is a beautiful natural light seen in the earth's sky.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Aurora Borealis**, also known as the Northern Lights, is a beautiful natural light display predominantly seen in high-latitude regions around the Arctic.
 
• It is caused by the collision of energetic charged particles with atoms in the high-altitude atmosphere (thermosphere).
